## Settings

| Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| query | `query` | Text | `SELECT * FROM input` |   | The run | Read-only SELECT over the input table. |
| input_alias | `input_alias` | Text | `input` |   | The run | Table name for the input inside the query. |
| input_aliases | `input_aliases` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Several inputs: comma-separated table names, one input pin each (e.g. chapters, manifest) |
| sql_contract_version | `sql_contract_version` | Fixed (set by the Engine) | `1` |   | The run | SQL step contract version (set by the engine) |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).
